record.paper_title: Enabling and Emerging Technologies for Social Distancing: A Comprehensive Survey and Open Problems
record.original_question: How can visible-light communication and positioning systems for social distancing maintain reliable indoor localization, navigation, crowd monitoring, assistance systems, and outdoor traffic-control communication when ambient light and sunlight interfere with visible-light communication channels and degrade RSS-based positioning or outdoor communication performance?

evidence.quote: Last but not least, the VLC technology can be a potential communication method between the intelligent traffic controlling system and vehicles in the outdoor environment.

However, the main disadvantage of the VLC technology is that interference from ambient and sun lights have significant impacts on the visible light communication channels [189], [191]. It results in poor performance of the RSS-based positioning approaches and outdoor communications.

artifact.status_search_result: Mitigating ambient-light and sunlight interference in VLC/VLP remains an active research area. Recent works propose optical band-pass filtering, DC-blocking and adaptive thresholding, OFDM-based modulation, machine-learning-based RSS calibration, and hybrid VLC/RF schemes, but no single solution provides comprehensive guarantees for all four of indoor localization, crowd monitoring, assistance systems, and outdoor vehicular VLC under strong sunlight. The problem is generally regarded as open.

status_evidence.title: A Survey on Visible Light Positioning Systems
status_evidence.snippet: Ambient light noise, including sunlight, remains one of the major challenges limiting the accuracy and robustness of RSS-based VLP systems.
status_evidence.claim: Ambient-light/sunlight interference is identified as an unresolved challenge for VLP.

status_evidence.title: Visible Light Communication for Vehicular Networks: Challenges
status_evidence.snippet: Solar irradiance and headlight interference cause severe SNR degradation in outdoor V2X VLC links; robust modulation and filtering are open research issues.
status_evidence.claim: Outdoor VLC for vehicular communication under sunlight is still an open problem.
